title: Shannon diversity and genome size across studies
legend: Top-ten-superfamily Shannon entropy for 11 published salamanders and 21 current Desmognathus species. Current estimated genome sizes and horizontal intervals are IOD-derived and anchored to the D. fuscus assembly in Gbp, not direct species C-values. Exact Wang et al. 2025 CC0 Dryad values use RepeatModeler/RepeatMasker; current indices use dnaPipeTE. Pipelines are not harmonized and no pooled fit or hypothesis test is shown.
